entries.15c9cfbdc1a5545f: Of the company's current 36 subsidiaries, 29 are located overseas. Of net sales of ¥481,148 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, ¥145,144 million was for customers in Japan, and the remainder was for customers in China and other regions.
entries.16aaf1a8a683c2f9: Effective April 1, 2026, the company reorganized 3 companies — ROHM Apollo Co., Ltd., ROHM Wako Co., Ltd. and ROHM Hamamatsu Co., Ltd. — into 2 companies: ROHM Device Manufacturing Co., Ltd., a front-end process manufacturing company, and ROHM Assembly Manufacturing Co., Ltd., a back-end process manufacturing company.
entries.1a99b8c856f52bc8: In August 1979, the company changed its trademark from R.ohm to ROHM, and in September 1981 it changed its trade name from Toyo Dengu Seisakusho Co., Ltd. to ROHM Co., Ltd.

entries.1b91332aae7545c1: SiCrystal GmbH remains a consolidated subsidiary today and manufactures raw materials for products handled by ROHM. entries.27cfffeeadf7d11e: This is a business that manufactures [[term:semiconductor|semiconductor]] integrated circuits (LSI) such as analog, logic and memory chips. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥218,390 million (up 7.1% year on year) and segment profit was ¥24,535 million. The company explains that products for body applications and xEVs grew in the automotive market, and that demand for amusement applications in the consumer equipment market and for servers in the computer & storage market recovered.
entries.2bff66e616ab5dea: This is a business that manufactures print heads and optical modules. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥31,589 million (down 3.0% year on year) and segment profit was ¥3,522 million. The company states that print heads increased for office equipment, while optical modules declined for in-vehicle LED modules.
